train_graph_model: train a GraphBasedModel to predict particle mobilities in glasses using TensorFlow and graph neural networks
apply_trained_model: apply a trained GraphModel checkpoint to predict particle mobilities on new glass simulation data files
load_simulation_data: load glass simulation data from pickle files and return particle positions, targets, types, and box dimensions
compute_loss_ops: compute L1 loss, L2 loss, and correlation metrics for predicted versus true particle mobilities on type A particles
get_particle_targets: compute averaged particle mobilities from sampled trajectory positions by calculating displacement norms across trajectories
